_how: Edit after each run: name/date/commit, the results.json files of the full run (first) and of performance, cross-browser and live, the performance results file used for the speed table, one entry in failures for each unexpected failure of the full run (test, device, cause, verdict, after_recheck; the report build stops until every failure is traced), any targeted re-runs (their results replace "Latest"), and append a row to history: [run, date, scope, passed, expected_fail, failed, flaky, duration, what happened]. Paths are relative to the repository root.
name: Run 10
label: Run 10 is the full regression run on the final, reviewed suite (2026-10-31, 2 workers, 60 minutes, another project's test runs loading the machine): chromium, phone, tablet, ipad and offline. It followed a review of every complex-tool and backup test that made 35 tests prove more (stored content, exact positions, what is on screen), added a page-in-view check to every page-number check, and found app defect DEF-213. Its 6 failures were each traced (see Run History and the failures table): 5 GitHub tests that hung together for 3 minutes under load and then passed 15 of 15 on re-check, and the intermittent tablet defect DEF-806. Performance comes from Performance 3 (alone, one worker; the machine was never quiet enough to re-measure fairly), cross-browser from Cross-browser 3, and the real-server results from Live 4 (REG-900 to REG-907).
